purpose.summary: This is a medical accounting/billing card input program (component J02) of the JMA ORCA standard receipt software system used in Japanese medical institutions. It handles patient accounting card entry, insurance combination checking, hospitalization records, and medical fee calculation. It is part of the Japan Medical Association's open-source clinic management system.

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based I/O only
Extensive Japanese comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Large program: ~15,786 lines, 97 CALL statements, 1,033 PERFORM statements
COPY statements referencing multiple include files (copybooks) for SPA areas and screen control
REDEFINES clauses used for display formatting (e.g. WRK-TENSU-X)
Indexed file organization with DYNAMIC access mode
Long revision history spanning 2000–2016 with multiple contributors
No COMP-3 usage despite being a financial/billing application
verdict.notes: The file is part of the well-known JMA ORCA (Open Receipt Computer for All) project, a Japanese open-source medical receipt/billing system. Japanese text in comments is EUC-JP encoded but was decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in the displayed text. The source is clearly genuine production COBOL targeting a Linux/Unix environment, most likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or OpenCOBOL. The truncation at 16,000 chars covers only the DATA DIVISION; the PROCEDURE DIVISION with the bulk of logic is not shown but is confirmed present by mechanical indicators.
